tasks.label: test
tasks.detail: Build and run the unit test suite (M13)

tasks.label: generate sample capture
tasks.detail: Builds a synthetic pcap with retransmissions, RSTs, DNS and ICMP

tasks.label: run: replay sample capture (no root needed)
run: live capture on loopback
tasks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then sudo ./build/netscope -i lo0; else sudo ./build/netscope -i lo; fi

tasks.label: grant capture permissions
tasks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then sudo chgrp admin /dev/bpf* && sudo chmod g+rw /dev/bpf* && echo 'BPF devices opened to the admin group (resets on reboot)'; else sudo setcap cap_net_raw,cap_net_admin=eip build/netscope && echo 'netscope can now capture without sudo'; fi
tasks.detail: Linux: setcap on the binary (re-run after each rebuild). macOS: opens /dev/bpf* to the admin group until reboot.

tasks.label: debug server: live capture under sudo gdbserver
tasks.detail: Start this, then use the 'Attach to live capture' launch config

tasks.label: run: capture to a pcap file
tasks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then sudo ./build/netscope -i lo0 -w captures/out.pcap -c 200; else sudo ./build/netscope -i lo -w captures/out.pcap -c 200; fi
